content:
Vector ingestion examines your domain or collection and their index. You can manually conﬁgure
your vector index ﬁelds or allow OpenSearch to use automatic conﬁguration.
Vector ingestion uses OpenSearch Ingestion (OSI) as the data pipeline between Amazon S3 and
OpenSearch. The service processes vectors in parallel to optimize ingestion speed while respecting
the scaling limits of both OSI and OpenSearch.
